data.name: No Mercy, No Sanctuary
data.detailed_description:
No Mercy, No Sanctuary is an uncompromising 2D survival shooter blending intense combat with base management. The world has collapsed, and your only goal is to survive one more night. But the danger doesn't just come from the darkness outside—it comes from the very people you try to save.

KEY FEATURES:

🧟 Visceral Combat & Physics

Shooting is more than just point-and-click. Experience realistic ballistics and a brutal body physics system. Use high-caliber rounds to tear through enemies or tactical dismemberment to slow them down. Every shot counts, and the recoil feels as heavy as the consequences of missing.

🔍 The Quarantine: Trust No One

Desperate survivors will knock on your door. You are the judge and the doctor. Inspect them closely for symptoms: a cough, pale skin, or nervous behavior could mean they are carrying the virus.

  • Admit the healthy: Gain a loyal fighter and worker for your base.

  • Admit the infected: They will turn inside your walls, causing chaos and slaughtering your team from within.

  • Reject the healthy: Lose valuable manpower and resources.

🏚️ Fortify & Craft

Your sanctuary is your fortress. Barricade windows, reinforce doors, and set up traps to create a layered defense system. Scavenge raw materials to craft essential ammunition and medicine. Manage your resources wisely—supplies are scarce, and the demand is high.

🌃 Relentless Day/Night Cycle

By day, venture into the city on dangerous expeditions. Use stealth and strategy to loot abandoned homes and stores. But when the sun sets, the rules change. Zombies become hyper-aggressive, forming hordes that will test your defenses to the limit.
